purpose: Dated public notes for the first source-backed task. Current product behavior is not established by this snapshot.

sources.title: Custom instructions with AGENTS.md
notes: One non-empty file per directory: override, standard name, then configured fallbacks.
Ordinary project notes require an explicit read.
Size-limit wording differs across guides; verify loading.

sources.title: Subagents and custom roles
sources.description: Delegation workflows and local custom-agent files, including role instructions and inherited configuration.
notes: Standalone role files require name, description, and developer_instructions.
Local role-file discovery is distinct from hosted Work subagent availability.
Parallel work uses additional tokens; use narrow assignments and clear file ownership.

sources.title: Build skills
sources.description: Reusable skill authoring, discovery, invocation metadata, and plugin distribution.
notes: SKILL.md needs a name and description; write precise triggers.
Local authoring paths are .agents/skills; plugins support distribution to other hosts.
Skills load progressively and do not merge solely because names match.
